name: playwright-bdd-framework
description: Playwright BDD Cucumber framework with POM, Allure, custom dashboard, BrowserStack, and local LLM triage

scripts.test:all-browsers: npm run test:chrome && npm run test:firefox && npm run test:webkit
scripts.test:headless: cross-env HEADLESS=true LOGIN_PAUSE_MS=0 SLOW_MO=0 KEEP_BROWSER_OPEN=false cucumber-js

scripts.report:all: npm run allure:generate && npm run report:custom && npm run report:extent && tsx src/ai/runTriage.ts
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d mysql postgres ollama dashboard
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile tests up --build --abort-on-container-exit tests
